text.p: Apple Computer Inc. said Wednesday it would offer mail-in cash rebates of up to $450 to buyers of Power Macintosh models 7600 and 8500.
The rebates will be valid between Dec. 9 and Jan. 19.
A customer who buys a qualifying 17-inch monitor at the same time as the Power Macintosh 8500 will receive a $250 rebate, while a more expensive 20-inch monitor will get a $450 rebate.
The purchase of a 17-inch monitor with a Power Macintosh 7600 or a 20-inch monitor makes customers eligible for $150 or $250 rebates, respectively.

The computer industry has been feeling jitters lately over fourth-quarter sales of personal computers to consumers after Circuit City Inc. reported lower-than-expected third quarter earnings and worse-than-expected PC sales.
